name: Chicago, IL
intro: A starter list, verified on Chicago Park District facility pages at chicagoparkdistrict.com as of November 27, 2026. The Park District pickleball courts directory lists 59 facilities with pickleball courts. This page lists a selection with published court details, including outdoor parks with dedicated or shared courts and park gyms with indoor pickleball space for colder months. Most facility pages do not publish open play times, fees, or skill levels. The Park District posts gym open play sessions through its events calendar and program registration, and those schedules change by season, so check there or call the park before your first visit. New to open play? Start with the national guides linked below, including our guides to indoor drop-in and pickleball scoring, or browse all US cities.
